sn55.30:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Vesāliyaṃ viharati Mahāvane Kuṭāgārasālāyaṃ || || 2.
sn55.30:1.2: Atha kho Nandako licchavimahāmatto yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || Ekam antaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Nandakaṃ licchavimahāmattam Bhagavā etad avoca || ||
sn55.30:2.1: Catuhi kho Nandaka dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano ||
sn55.30:2.3: Idha Nandaka ariyasāvako Buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti ||
sn55.30:2.4: Iti pi so Bhagavā || la-pe || satthā devamanussānam buddho bhagavā ti ||
sn55.30:2.7: Ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi || la-pe || samādhisaṃvattanikehi || ||
sn55.30:2.8: Imehi kho Nandaka catuhi dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano || || 4.
sn55.30:3.1: Imehi ca pana Nandaka catuhi dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako āyunā samyutto hoti dibbena pi mānussena pi ||
sn55.30:3.5: adhipateyyena samyutto hoti dibbena pi mānussena pi || || 5.
sn55.30:3.6: Taṃ kho panāhaṃ Nandaka nāññassa samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā sutvā vadāmi || api ca yad eva mayā sāmaṃ ñātaṃ sāmaṃ diṭṭhaṃ sāmaṃ viditaṃ tad evāhaṃ vadāmī ti || || 6.
sn55.30:4.1: Evam vutte aññataro puriso Nandakaṃ licchaviṃ mahāmattaṃ etad avoca ||
sn55.30:4.3: Alaṃ dāni bhaṇe etena bāhirena nahānena
sn55.30:4.4: alam idam ajjhattaṃ nahānaṃ bhavissati yad idam
